// Generated by scripts/ui/codegen.mjs from demo.steps.json. Do not edit: change the journey and rerun it.
// candidate: pending
import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test';
import { seedApp, type SeededApp } from './harness';

test.use({ viewport: { width: 360, height: 800 } });

test('demo: Demo', async ({ page }) => {
  let app: SeededApp | undefined;
  const url = (path: string): string => {
    if (app === undefined) throw new Error('no app seeded yet');
    return `${app.url}${path}`;
  };
  try {
    await expect(page.getByText('Before anything').first()).toBeVisible();
    // 1: seed ["musterstadt-baeume"]
    app = await seedApp(page, 'musterstadt-baeume');
    // 2: open ["http://127.0.0.1:41234/admin/projects/musterstadtbaeume/types/baum/builder"]
    await page.goto(url('/admin/projects/musterstadtbaeume/types/baum/builder'));
    await expect(page.getByRole('navigation', { name: 'Path', exact: true })).toBeVisible();
    // 3: click {"role":"button","name":"Outline"}
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Outline', exact: true }).click();
    // 4: click {"role":"link","name":"Tree's type","nth":1}
    await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Tree\'s type', exact: true }).nth(1).click();
    await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Tree', exact: true })).toContainText('Tree');
    await expect(page.getByRole('listitem', { name: 'Row', exact: true })).toHaveCount(3);
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(new RegExp('\\/admin\\/projects\\/musterstadtbaeume\\/types\\/baum\\/builder'));
    // 5: fill {"testid":"name-input"} ["Oak"]
    await page.getByTestId('name-input').fill('Oak');
    // 6: fill {"label":"Password"} ["a\\b"]
    await page.getByLabel('Password', { exact: true }).fill('a\\b');
    // 7: select {"role":"combobox","name":"Offered on"} ["tree"]
    await page.getByRole('combobox', { name: 'Offered on', exact: true }).selectOption('tree');
    // 8: press ["Enter"]
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    // 9: wait ["Saved"]
    await expect(page.getByText('Saved').first()).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByText('Saved').first()).toBeVisible();
    // 10: wait {"role":"status","name":"Save status"}
    await expect(page.getByRole('status', { name: 'Save status', exact: true })).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('spinner')).toBeHidden();
    await expect(page.getByLabel('Name', { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
    // 11: click {"testid":"row","nth":2}
    await page.getByTestId('row').nth(2).click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('row')).toHaveCount(4);
    // 12: click {"label":"Name","nth":0}
    await page.getByLabel('Name', { exact: true }).nth(0).click();
    await expect(page.getByLabel('Name', { exact: true })).toContainText('Oak');
  } finally {
    await app?.stop();
  }
});
